metadata.title: बसवराजु एनकाउंटर की कहानी और संदेश | Full Story of the Basavaraju Encounter
metadata.description:
On May 21, 2025, deep inside the forests of Abujhmad in Chhattisgarh, India's internal security forces claimed one of their biggest victories — CPI (Maoist) General Secretary and top commander Nambala Keshav Rao alias Basavaraju was killed in an encounter, along with 26 other Maoists.

In this episode, Shyam Sunder takes you through the full sequence of events — how the police tracked Basavaraju, the controversy over the handling of the bodies, and what the Maoists have to say in their official response.

We ask the critical question: Is the Maoist movement, once deeply rooted in India's tribal regions, now in its final phase? Why are more and more tribal youth leaving the Maoist ranks and joining the police forces? Is the tribal population disillusioned with the Maoist ideology?

Key highlights of this episode:

Timeline of the 3-day-long encounter in Abujhmad

Allegations from Basavaraju’s family over the cremation

Human rights concerns raised by activist Bela Bhatia

A detailed response from the Maoists and a rebuttal by the police

Analysis of what this means for the future of armed insurgency in tribal India

Tune in for an in-depth, ground-connected report on one of the most important stories from India’s heartland.

#Maoists #Basavaraju #AbujhmadEncounter #Naxalism #TribalIndia #Chhattisgarh #HumanRights #MainBhiBharat
